card.name: Dose-range wording after numbers
card.fires_on: Words that complete a quantity or dose statement, such as units, mg, IU or ratio right after a number or range. Mostly in dosing sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: The unit word right after a dose or intake figure.
modes.example: The recommended intake of vitamin D is 400-800 international<< units>> daily.

modes.label: Ratio or half-time wording
modes.description: The word finishing a ratio or a time-span phrase in dosing text.
modes.example: Dipyridamole Injection should be diluted in at least a 1:2<< ratio>> with sodium chloride injection 0.4

modes.label: Dose adjustment verb
modes.description: A verb that says how the dose is changed for a patient group.
modes.example: Dosages of mepivacaine hydrochloride should be<< reduced>> for elderly and debilitated patients and

card.writes: It seems to steer away from the word range and toward other words, with no clear theme.
card.plain: It lights up on the word that finishes a dose amount, like units or mg after a number.
